prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / targeted pixel portrait revision.
Asset type: one 74x100 low-resolution medieval RPG dialogue portrait.
Input images: Image 1 is Elen v1, the edit target. Images 2-5 are approved Mara, Ivo, Rhea and Tor style/face-coverage anchors ONLY.
Make one targeted revision of Image 1. KEEP the SAME Elen (艾伦, BRY-NPC-ELEN): female around forty, mature narrow oval face, long distinct nose, warm tan complexion, dark chestnut side-parted hair in a low bun, burgundy work robe converted from an old university garment with charcoal-gray working apron and muted linen. Not Aren the male deserter. Keep her womanly adult identity; do not masculinize, rejuvenate, beautify, change hair color, invent headwear or turn her into a scholar with authority.
Required correction, expression: replace the raised inner worried brow peaks with nearly level, slightly lowered concentrating brows. Small dark eyes closely inspect the listener, upper lids press slightly down; ivory sclera only one dim tan sliver, not large white blocks. Elen is scrutinizing whether a claim is exact, firm and gently pressuring, not distressed, not sad, not angry, no Mara-like worried eyebrow expression. Preserve adult cheekbone and under-eye anatomy but reduce shadow arrangement that reads as sorrow. Keep her thin closed measured mouth.
Required correction, framing: enlarge the face within the SAME 74x100 composition and shorten the visible bare neck dramatically. Target chin at around y=87, ONLY 3-5 target pixels of bare neck below it, with a HIGH plain burgundy work-smock neckline and charcoal apron edge filling the remaining bottom 8-10 pixels. A tiny muted cream linen edge may show, but no open V-neck, cleavage, long bare throat, large shoulders or chest. Hair crown near y=2 and cheek/hair mass nearly fills width. The existing v1 long exposed neck must disappear through actual redrawing, not stretching.
Required correction, hair: simplify side locks into just 2 or 3 broad connected dark masses; preserve the low bun and side part. Reduce thin parallel highlight streaks and loose dangling strands. Do not crop off the bun or skull.
Style/medium: authoritative coarse logical pixel clusters, hard angular planes on nose/cheek and stair-step edges, muted warm terracotta skin ramps and dark warm-brown outlines. Think directly as 74 by 100 square pixels; if output is larger it should be a uniform enlargement of that grid. Keep maximum 32 intentional visible colors, no smooth gradients, antialiasing, noise, dithering, beauty lighting or miniature painted detail.
True transparent alpha outside the single head silhouette. No border, text, UI, props, hands, tools, spectacles, university insignia or extra person. Preserve original pixels only where they serve these focused redrawing corrections.
